text:
Ana: Quick sync — planning a short-form launch push next Tue. Want to test small credit drip + 30‑min live miniworkshop vs recorded webinar. Hypothesis: microworkshop increases first-10-requests conversion by ~20% :chart_with_upwards_trend:
James: Sounds good. Which cohorts are we targeting? Seed users or open signups?
Ana: Primary: seed cohort = users with >5 token usage in the last 7 days. Secondary: recent signups from last 14 days with 0-3 requests. Flow idea: 50 starter credits on sign-up; if they join the live miniworkshop we top up +150 credits. Also include a 'starter prompts' template pack during workshop.
Maria: Nice. Two-arm A/B: (A) credit-only drip, (B) credit + live workshop + prompts. Primary metric: pct of users reaching 10 requests in 7 days. Secondary: avg tokens/request and retention at 14 days.
Eve: Will design short social cards and a 120s demo clip for the workshop landing. Quick ask: can we keep messaging tight — 'Get 200 free credits + hands-on prompts' :sparkles:
James: For routing, let's auto-invite inbound leads that match these rules:
``
if lead.source == "demo_form" and lead.company_size in ["1-10","11-50"]:
  auto_invite(workshop)
else:
  send_credit_drip()
```
Can eng ops help with the webhook deploy?
ops-bot: Campaign created: campaign_id=789213, scheduled start=1769999500
Ana: I'll own GA events and the experiment flag. Maria — can you own the benchmark narrative? Need a short doc for execs summarizing baseline -> experiment -> expected lift.
Maria: Yep, will draft a 1-pager. Also suggest we add one 'prompt efficacy' micro-eval for the starter pack after workshop to catch immediate quality regressions.
James: I'll draft landing copy + CTA variants tonight and share in #marketing-drafts. Next steps: design assets by Thu, routing webhook by Fri, ops to schedule campaign next Mon. :thumbsup:
